name: Ishiel Soel
source: Ishiel is the first one to find Makoto and Fujisawa when they arrived. Normally she is the Priestess of Nature, but about the time the Earth People arrive, her season is over, and she takes to wandering. Her element of Nature allows her to create fissures in the land to send opponents careening into a pit or rupture around the opponenet to bury them.
